operator: Angel City Air (electronic news-gathering contractor for NBC4/Telemundo 52 'NewsChopper4'); aircraft registered owner reported as Tiny Bubbles Aviation Inc., Pacoima, CA
narrative: NEWS-SOURCED, NOT FROM AN NTSB REPORT (none exists yet). On the evening of September 15, 2026, a Eurocopter AS350 B2 helicopter (registration N358TV), operating as 'NewsChopper4' for NBC4 Los Angeles / Telemundo 52, was providing live aerial coverage of a fatal SUV-vs-Metro-bus collision in Chatsworth, California. The helicopter had reportedly been hovering/orbiting at low altitude over the collision scene. Witnesses described the helicopter appearing to sway before it descended; it crashed into a parking lot between two commercial buildings in the 9100 block of North Mason Avenue around 7:00 p.m. local time and caught fire, damaging several parked cars and storage containers. The pilot (George Marciniw) and the onboard reporter (Eliana Moreno) were killed, as was a bystander on the ground (29-year-old Edy Gutierrez Mejia); news reports differ on whether one or two additional people were injured on the ground, and none specify injury severity. NTSB investigator-in-charge Fabian Salazar said the live broadcast audio captured sounds consistent with changing engine speed and tones resembling cockpit advisories, and called it important evidence; he explicitly said no cause has been determined and that altitude, the crash sequence, and whether the aircraft was operating in or out of ground effect are all still under review.
phase_of_flight: Reported as hovering/low-altitude orbit over an active incident scene at the time of the upset (NEWS-SOURCED characterization; NTSB has not published an official phase-of-flight finding)
weather: Not reported by NTSB or by any news source reviewed; unknown at this time
